slides.title: Strong Buying / Selling Absorption
slides.text:
• CONTEXT: 4142 has been a KEY LEVEL which has acted as support once above and resistance once below.
• Last week broke out of balance + returned BACK into balance. 4142 is about the midpoint of previous balance range.
• Overnight relatively flat finding support around 4142/40s
• Execution: Market opens and immediately sells off into this 4142/4140 region.
• There is TONS of aggressive selling at this level yet market is failing to move LOWER.
• 6+ tests (moved off the level and returned)
• Market reversed after sellers gave up + buyers stepped in.
